meta.name: ai-gateway
meta.description: Reference for the studio/ai-gateway service — the single shared entry point every other service uses to reach Claude, Gemini, and MiniMax. Use this when any service needs a new AI capability, when adding/editing system prompts or tool definitions, or when changing which provider handles which task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照网关文档,为服务接入 AI 模型并配置提示词
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你正给服务接入或调整 AI 功能
copy.tagline_en: Use the gateway reference to add AI models and manage prompts for your services.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are adding or adjusting AI capabilities in your services.

howto.what: 装着后，Claude 会了解 ai-gateway 是统一 AI 入口：每个请求经四个端点转发给不同模型，提示词按上下文存在独立文件，每次调用必写成本日志。要新增能力或改提示词，Claude 会遵循流程。
howto.when: 当某个服务需要新的 AI 能力、修改系统提示词或工具定义、或更换处理任务的模型厂商时。

say.text: 我想把 dubbing 的翻译从 MiniMax 换到 Gemini，该改哪里？
say.note: Claude 会指出路由配置和提示词文件。

say.text: 帮我排查 ai_requests 日志里费用最高的请求。
say.note: Claude 会先查成本日志，这是规定入口。

howto.what_en: Claude learns ai-gateway is the single AI entry: four endpoints route to Claude/MiniMax/Gemini; prompts stored per context; every call logs cost. Adding new AI capability or prompts follows the process.
howto.when_en: When a service needs a new AI capability, edits system prompts or tool definitions, or changes which provider handles a task.

say_en.text: How do I add a new context for member points lookup in ai-gateway?
say_en.note: Claude walks through endpoints, prompt files, and cost logs.

say_en.text: How do I switch dubbing translation from MiniMax to Gemini?
say_en.note: Claude points out routing config and prompt file.

say_en.text: Find the most expensive requests in the ai_requests log.
say_en.note: Claude checks cost log first as the standard entry point.
